prompt: Run the llm-working2grid ablation baseline for as-jpn-tokyo-jr-shape-rect (variant orig) with model opus5: lay out every point of the working map on a grid from scratch, deciding each cell by reasoning, then apply.

transcript.note: Round 1, whole grid laid out from geography. (1) Interchanges first: I fixed the Yamanote loop frame — west edge as one column (8 池袋/35 高田馬場/85/22 新宿/39 代々木/26 明治神宮前/53 渋谷/17 恵比寿, 7 vertical segments) and the north edge as one row (8-38 巣鴨-30 駒込-61 西日暮里), then hung everything else off that frame. (2) One line, one direction: the Shinjuku-line east-west spine 12 東新宿-29 飯田橋-27 九段下-45 神保町-44 小川町-82-55 秋葉原-68 東日本橋 became a single row (6 horizontals); the Hibiya/Chiyoda spine 49 溜池山王-48 霞ケ関-46 日比谷-56 銀座-5 東銀座-6 築地 became another (5 horizontals); the Oedo/Marunouchi row 37 春日-78 本郷三丁目-92-40 上野御徒町-69 蔵前 a third; and I built a vertical through the core at 56 銀座-47 東京-2 大手町-44 小川町 and a row-14 chain 2-83-10 三越前-79 人形町-43 清澄白河. (3) Compass kept: columns are a rank map of gx and rows a rank map of gy, so east/north order is preserved everywhere except deliberate ties where I merged near-identical coordinates onto one line. (4) Tightened the dense Otemachi/Nihonbashi core into adjacent cells and compressed the sparse east (西船橋/本八幡) and north-west (和光市/西高島平) tails; then removed every empty row and column, 50x30 -> 46x25. Verified before submitting: edge winding order 0 violations, 0 collisions, 0 vtxOn. The 2 remaining crossings (13 白金高輪-36 三田 vs 11 大門-71 五反田, and 36-94 vs 11-71) are crossings that exist in the real geography too, not artefacts of the layout.
